states.title: The outcome is not confirmed

states.title: The action did not complete

states.body: Public pages remain available. Opening retained private work requires current verified access; this fixture does not restore it.

states.held: D-076 selects visitor access expiry after 30 minutes of inactivity or an authorized End, with no absolute conversation duration. Warning and More time remain required. Restoration mechanisms and complete-process accessibility evidence remain held; booking and staff clocks are separate. Do not invent a sign-in or restore mechanism.

states.title: This view is out of date

states.truth: Earlier confirmed state, not current authority

states.title: The information changed
states.body: No new change is confirmed. Review the current authoritative version before deciding what to do.
states.truth: Current/previous version distinction; no automatic overwrite or retry

states.title: An optional visual could not load

states.title: New content was not verified
states.body: The unverified replacement was not activated. This fixture keeps the prior complete eligible release without mixing content.
states.truth: Prior confirmed release only; candidate remains inactive

states.title: Focus appearance requirement

surfaces.limit: Editable appearance and semantic role annotations only; actual OS/browser forced-colours mapping and behavior require later runtime evidence

profile.applies_to: Shared system status and recovery presentation
profile.minimum_evidence: Reusable focused frames for each class on light/dark/forced-color surfaces; route/flow host retains context
profile.annotation_requirements: What happened; what was preserved; authoritative state; smallest safe action; status semantics; no provider/secret/PII leakage
profile.exception_rule: This profile supplements rather than replaces a host template state profile

limitations: State language is proposed synthetic copy; no real service, record, staff availability, account existence, admission, cache, storage, retry, permission or restoration is claimed
Unknown/pending business outcomes must reconcile the same operation, not reuse a generic fresh retry
Anonymous recovery must not invent Microsoft/staff sign-in; accepted staff expiry remains a separate profile
Every class needs its own light/dark/forced-colour reference under the accepted profile; deduplication must name each applicable stream/profile without losing an obligation
Exact copy, token bindings, prototype, narrow/landscape/desktop/400% evidence, primitive states, independent review, export/restore/EXIT and founder pilot acceptance remain
Prepared successor only; source review and immediate scoped call permission/allowance required. No new Figma nodes claimed.
Historical fixture hashes are preserved separately. Current file identities do not establish independent re-review of all current source documents.
48 narrow shared grammar specimens supplement host coverage. Focus rings, forced-colours execution and complete-process behavior remain separate obligations.
